description: Implementation of the Device.WiFi.Radio.Stats API, including functions to retrieve WiFi radio statistics such as bytes sent/received, packets, errors, noise floor, and traffic stats, with support for external modules via IARM bus or direct system calls.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_Radio_Stats
classes.description: Class managing WiFi radio statistics, including instance management, data retrieval, and system interaction.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of hostIf_WiFi_Radio_Stats for a given device ID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_Props_Fields
methods.description: Fetches WiFi radio properties either via IARM bus or system calls.

methods.name: checkWifiRadioPropsFetch
methods.description: Periodically refreshes WiFi radio properties based on a time interval.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesSent
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes sent over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes received over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsSent
methods.description: Returns the number of packets sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of packets received.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsSent
methods.description: Returns the number of errors sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of errors received.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsSent
methods.description: Returns the number of discard packets sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of discard packets received.
